la Vila de Gràcia — Barcelona, Spain

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

By day, la Vila de Gràcia shows no specific incident reports. By night the picture is mixed: beteve.cat reported a wave of night-time break-ins at shops/bars along Carrer de la Providència, forcing extra patrols. Plaça del Sol/Plaça de la Vila have a long-documented chronic 'botellón'/noise problem, and Festa Major de Gràcia (mid-August) sees a very large annual police deployment targeting theft, disorder and (in past years) reported sexual-assault incidents linked to festival crowds. Sources checked: beteve.cat; ARA.cat.
